thread:
alex: quick ping — opened PR that tweaks the TF for our KMS grants in staging. after merge some pods started failing decrypts (500) when calling our secrets sidecar. can someone eyeball? PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/2345
priya: can you drop the error log and which terraform resources changed?
alex: error from sidecar: 
```
2026-03-16T14:02:11Z ERROR kms decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: Caller is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01
```
changed these in PR: 
- removed aws_kms_grant with explicit grantee_principal set to role ARN; switched to aws_iam_role_policy attachment + key policy update to include role
- added condition on kms:ViaService for sts.amazonaws.com (attempted to tighten)
josh: hmm — two quick things to check: 1) If you're assuming roles via IRSA the principal at decrypt time is the role session, not the role ARN. if the grant uses the role ARN as grantee_principal it usually works but if you add conditions like aws:SourceIdentity or session tags it can break. 2) encryption context mismatch can also cause AccessDenied — do we add any ctx in the sidecar?
sophie: also double-check the key policy. we need both the IAM principal allow in key policy and/or an explicit grant for the role/session. tf changes that remove the grant can surface if the role used is a session (sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity).
alex: sidecar does not set an encryption context explicitly. this started after removing the aws_kms_grant and relying solely on key policy + iam policy.
priya: can you paste the TF snippets you changed?
alex: sure: 
```
resource "aws_kms_key" "main" {
  description = "service key"
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.kms_policy.json
}

# removed previous grant
#resource "aws_kms_grant" "sidecar_grant" {
#  key_id = aws_kms_key.main.key_id
#  grantee_principal = aws_iam_role.sidecar_role.arn
#  operations = ["Decrypt", "Encrypt"]
#}

# now rely on key policy + role attachment
resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "attach" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.sidecar_role.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.sidecar_kms_access.arn
}
```
josh: ok — two follow-ups: a) check CloudTrail events for kms:Decrypt to see the principal in the event (it will show assumed-role/session). b) if you tightened kms:ViaService to sts.amazonaws.com, that condition is weird — kms:ViaService is normally used for requests coming through another AWS service like s3.amazonaws.com. For STS assume role flows you probably don't want that.
priya: i'll check cloudtrail quickly.
(priya posts later) priya: cloudtrail shows principal: arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/sidecar-role/i-1234567890abcd and requestContext shows no encryptionContext.
sophie: there you go — the grant removal likely matters because when the principal is assumed-role session arn some key policies that name the role arn are not matching unless you allow sts:AssumeRole session ARNs or use the wildcard principal in the key policy. grants are sometimes safer for short-term sessions.
alex: ok makes sense. should we revert the PR to restore the aws_kms_grant and iterate on tightening the key policy separately?
josh: yes revert for now, add an automated integration test that exercises assume-role via IRSA in staging — the test should call KMS decrypt with a pod and assert success. also consider adding an explicit kms grant with grantee_principal = "arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/*"? not sure TF supports wildcards there but grants accept principal ARNs.
sophie: terraform aws_kms_grant grantee_principal must be an AWS principal. wildcard assumed-role ARNs are not ideal. best is grant the role ARN and include condition in grant for aws:PrincipalArn? it's messy. key policy that allows the role or the account KMS principal is more explicit.
alex: i'll revert + open follow-up ticket to add CloudTrail test + integration test. also will add a short doc in infra/notes about "IRSA and KMS grants gotchas". cc @infra-bot to run the revert pipeline. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: build triggered: infra-revert-2345 on staging (job 4521)
ci-bot: quick note — recommend adding acceptance test in `tests/kms_irsa` that runs in staging with a service account.
alex: thanks all. will revert and loop back with a smaller change.
priya: thanks for the quick triage.
sophie: yay less outage. :party_face:
